name: ink-tui-wizard
author: novuhq
description: Build terminal user interfaces (TUIs) using Ink (React for CLIs) and @inkjs/ui with a reactive, session-driven wizard pattern. Use when creating interactive CLI installation wizards, setup flows, or multi-step terminal applications in Node.js/TypeScript. Covers reactive screen resolution, declarative flow pipelines, overlay interrupts, session state management, Ink components, Flexbox terminal layout, and graceful degradation across terminal environments.
